skill.name: chronicle-project-tracker
skill.description: Manage Chronicle project milestones, next steps, roadmap views, progress reports, and session links through Chronicle MCP tools or CLI workflows.
skill.summary: Track Chronicle milestones, roadmap status, next steps, and linked development sessions.
skill.author: ChandlerHardy

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, Chronicle CLI examples, and MCP tool names. I found no prompt injection attempt, hidden exfiltration intent, or malicious system reconnaissance in SKILL.md. Users should still review optional Chronicle CLI updates because they can change local project tracking state.

content.value_statement: Development work can become hard to connect to milestones, sessions, and roadmap priorities. This skill uses Chronicle MCP tools and CLI workflows to track progress and next steps.
actual_capabilities: Lists Chronicle milestones by status, type, or priority.
Shows roadmap sections for active work, planned work, next steps, and recent completions.
Links development sessions to milestones for project history and reporting.
Marks milestones or next steps complete using Chronicle MCP tools or CLI commands.
Generates progress summaries from completed milestones, sessions, commits, and durations.
Explains Chronicle project tracking tables and fields for structured reporting.
limitations: Requires Chronicle project tracking data and compatible MCP tools or CLI commands.
Does not manage projects outside the Chronicle data model.
CLI updates depend on local Chronicle installation and user permissions.
Roadmap quality depends on accurate milestones, tags, priorities, and session links.

use_cases.title: Plan Feature Work
use_cases.description: Review the existing roadmap, create a milestone, and break the feature into prioritized next steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare Progress Reports
use_cases.description: Summarize completed milestones, linked sessions, commits, and remaining work for a reporting period.

use_cases.title: Connect Sessions to Roadmap Items
use_cases.description: Find the active milestone, link a development session, and mark completed next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Show My Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the Chronicle roadmap for the next 7 days and group it by active work, planned work, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the current Chronicle roadmap for duplicate work, then draft a milestone and three next steps for this feature: [feature].

prompt_templates.title: Link Recent Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the most recent Chronicle session, identify the active milestone, and prepare the steps to link them safely.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Weekly Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a weekly Chronicle progress report from completed milestones, linked sessions, commits, durations, and pending next steps.

output_examples.input: What should I work on next?
output_examples.output: A ranked roadmap summary with active milestones, high priority planned work, pending next steps, and recent completions.

output_examples.input: What did I accomplish this week?
output_examples.output: A progress report that groups completed milestones with linked sessions, commits, time spent, and key files changed.

output_examples.input: Help me start a new API milestone.
output_examples.output: A suggested milestone title, description, priority, tags, and a short list of next steps to add in Chronicle.

best_practices: Review the roadmap before creating new milestones to avoid duplicate work.
Link sessions while work is fresh so reports stay accurate.
Use consistent milestone types, priorities, and tags for reliable filtering.
anti_patterns: Creating milestones without checking existing active or planned work.
Marking milestones complete before all required next steps are resolved.
Using vague tags or priorities that make roadmap ordering unclear.

faq.question: What does this skill track?
faq.answer: It tracks Chronicle milestones, next steps, roadmap status, linked sessions, commits, and progress summaries.

faq.question: Does it require MCP tools?
faq.answer: MCP tools are preferred for structured access, but the skill also documents Chronicle CLI workflows.

faq.question: Can it create milestones automatically?
faq.answer: It can prepare or invoke Chronicle milestone workflows when the available tool permissions allow updates.

faq.question: Can it update documentation files?
faq.answer: It can generate documentation content from Chronicle data, but file updates depend on the assistant environment.

faq.question: Is this a general project management skill?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for Chronicle project tracking data and Chronicle workflow conventions.

faq.question: How should commands be handled?
faq.answer: Review Chronicle CLI commands before execution, especially commands that complete milestones or link sessions.
